findings.title: Replay ignores recorded backend identities
findings.why_it_matters: The run records Gmsh, ElmerGrid, ElmerSolver, their libraries, and the executable in backend_hashes, but replay never checks those paths or the command records. After a backend is replaced or disappears, the old mesh/log/scalar bundle still returns a verified conditional assessment, so the acceptance result is no longer tied to the tools that produced it and stale or partial solver output can be presented as current evidence.
findings.suggested_fix: During replay, iterate report.backend_hashes and rehash every recorded executable/library, failing closed (or explicitly returning indeterminate when the recorded path is unavailable); also validate the retained command metadata before accepting the raw outputs.

residual_risks: bridge_thermal::branch_current uses starts_with on UUID-plus-segment IDs (zapote/packages/zapote-harness/src/bridge_thermal.rs:206-209); a future generated branch such as UUID:20000 can satisfy the UUID:2 lookup and bind a thermal case to the wrong segment. Exact-ID lookup plus a collision regression is still needed.
testing_gaps: No replay test changes a recorded backend binary/hash or command record and asserts that replay rejects the bundle; the existing mutations cover board/native/SIF/scalars and missing solver.log only.
